content.value: A single acting reciprocating pump has a plunger of 80 mm diameter and stroke length of 150 mm. It takes its supply of water from a sump 3 m below the pump through a pipe 4.5 m long and 30 mm diameter. It delivers water to a tank 12 m above the pump through a pipe 25 mm in diameter and 15 m long.
If separation occurs at 78.48 kN/m² below atmospheric pressure, find the maximum speed at which the pump may be operated without separation, assume the plunger to have simple harmonic motion.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
